name: Ms. Sharleen
summary: A Key Lento resident on Calypso Avenue who holds a yard sale where Jason can buy clothes.
body: GTA Wiki (edited November 19, 2026) lists Ms. Sharleen as a minor character who lives on Calypso Avenue in Key Lento and is hosting a yard sale.
According to GTA Wiki, Jason can buy a T-shirt, shoes and sunglasses at her yard sale.
GTA Wiki says she keeps a pet alligator called Gary, who wears a cowboy hat.

name: Peggy
summary: One of Jason's neighbours on Peach Palm Drive in Key Lento, and the owner of the scooter in Shirley's errand.
body: GTA Wiki (edited November 19, 2026) lists Peggy as a minor character: one of Jason Duval's neighbours on Peach Palm Drive in Key Lento and a friend of Shirley Baker.
GTA Wiki ties her to Shirley's errand in which Jason takes Peggy's Boomazoom mobility scooter; the app's Shirley: Steal the Scooter entry covers that errand.

name: Joe
summary: Lucia's probation officer, with the Key Lento Police Department.
body: GTA Wiki (edited November 19, 2026) lists Joe as a minor character: a probation officer with the Key Lento Police Department assigned to Lucia Caminos.
GTA Wiki names the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth as his main appearance.
